reviews.title: Refurbished product no complaints
reviews.comment: I bought this from Computer Headquarters Certified Refurbished about 7 months ago. I gotta say It works like a charm. It was in its original packaging and came with some documentation that I cannot exactly remember off the top of my head. I was apprehensive about purchasing this item, but it was a good deal. At the moment I could not be happier. It has performed as expected and I haven't experienced any issues. If this changes in the future I will be sure to update my review but again, 7 months in and 0 issues.
reviews.author: Alfredo Eustaquio
